No bill-of-lading number, date, destination or HS code could be extracted from any free source (volza.com/p/pharmaexcil/ and eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403).
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or supply contract found for PHARMEXCIL as a supplier. Its own site (pharmexcil.com) describes it as 'PHARMACEUTICALS EXPORT PROMOTION COUNCIL OF INDIA' with sections 'Role of Council', 'Membership Application Form', 'RCMC', 'MAI Scheme', 'Export Performance Dashboard' — i.e. a council that issues Registration-Cum-Membership Certificates and administers export incentives for its members, not a party that ships goods. The Export Performance Dashboard page (pharmexcil.com/export-performance-dashboard) is JS-rendered and returned no data rows; it aggregates DGCIS statistics for the sector, not shipments by the entity.
note: IMPORTANT IDENTITY ISSUE: 'Pharmaexcil' is not a trading or manufacturing company — it is the Pharmaceuticals Export Promotion Council of India, a government-sponsored, non-profit export promotion council (Hyderabad) that regulates and promotes pharma exports and issues RCMCs to member exporters. It has no goods to ship, so declared HS 300490 and industry 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil/gas & chemicals) are both misattributed: the council's domain is pharmaceuticals, and it is not an oil/gas or chemicals supplier at all. Per project rules this is not a rejection ground (entity exists and is active), but it should be reclassified as a non-supplier / industry body rather than a supplier record.
